rules.description: Frontend must not own sidecar lifecycle
Product runtime must not fallback to system Python
Listeners must remain loopback-only
UI must not render internal enums directly
MCP cannot mutate LocalBridge control-plane
Whole-app elevation is forbidden
Runtime self-update is forbidden
Telemetry endpoints are forbidden
External runtime access must go through stable adapters
Dashboard current-task UI is one ephemeral status projection, not an activity feed
Task summaries must be secret-redacted before UI projection
Task status source must be actual MCP/Broker execution, not model prose
Dashboard execution status must be one inline presentation without section/field labels
Active task indicator uses presentation-level motion and must respect prefers-reduced-motion
Secrets must not be persisted in plaintext settings or frontend storage
Runtime API Key must not appear in spawned process command-line arguments
Remembered workspace registry must not be treated as simultaneous MCP authorization roots
Workspace removal must never perform filesystem deletion
MCP tools cannot mutate workspace registry or active workspace
Recoverable runtime outages use exactly five bounded reconnect attempts before user attention
Reconnect attempts before exhaustion must not create new user notifications or retry UI
One outage generation may emit at most one reconnect-exhaustion error window
Apple-inspired styling must not add UI/animation/icon/CSS-framework/font dependencies
Next PR group cannot become READY until previous group independent adversarial review is PASS
